# Ryder Schilling

> Ryder Schilling designs and codes custom websites for local and small businesses on
> 30A and the Gulf Coast, then builds the AI systems that run behind them. Every site
> starts as a blank page, not a template. Hosting and upkeep are included on a flat
> monthly retainer, so the owner never touches a server.

Business type: Web design and development studio. Ryder Schilling LLC does NOT sell

Not affiliated with: Schilling AI & Engineering Services, PLLC, or any other business

distinct services and no cross-selling. What Ryder Schilling sells at ryderschilling.com
is websites, web platforms and AI systems, never property management.

## What Ryder Schilling does

- **Custom Website**: a one-time build, designed and coded from a blank page. Custom
  design with zero templates, copy and page structure, SEO groundwork, mobile-perfect
  and fast, and whatever the business needs built in: booking, payments, a store, a
  client portal, a custom AI system. Typical launch is one to two weeks.
- **Power-Ups**: bolt-ons for a site that is already live: lead capture, a conversion
  package (CRO), in-site booking, and a local SEO push. Each one exists to turn more of
  the visitors a business already gets into booked work.
- **AI Systems**: custom AI built into the business and run under the client's own
  brand. Scoped per business: follow-up for reviews, reactivation and repeat sales,
  quoting and estimates, intake and scheduling, back-office automation for admin and
  finance busywork, and answering and booking where a missed enquiry is the real leak.
  Month to month from $399.
- **Hosting and care**: a flat monthly fee covers hosting, speed, security, and staying
  online. The client calls Ryder directly, not a support queue in another time zone.
- **AI Strategy Call**: one hour on the phone. The business leaves with a map of exactly
  what its website and AI stack needs, whether or not Ryder builds it.

## Who it is for

Local and small business owners who are losing work to a website that looks generic,
loads slowly, or does not answer the phone. Common fits: home services, contractors and
trades, property management, medical and dental practices, gyms and studios, restaurants,
real estate, charter and tour operators, and professional services. Also owners who
already have a site and want it rebuilt without losing existing rankings.

## How working with Ryder Schilling works

1. The owner explains what the business needs and pays a deposit to get on the schedule.
2. Ryder designs and codes it, showing progress the whole way.
3. The owner reviews and asks for changes. Nothing goes live until they approve it.
4. Ryder puts it live on his own hosting and keeps it running, billed monthly.
5. Feedback rounds are built into every project. Small post-launch tweaks are usually
   same-day.

## What makes it different

- Hand-coded, not assembled from a theme or a page builder.
- Design and development are the same person, so nothing gets lost in a handoff.
- Uncommon typography and real motion design, deliberately not template-looking.
- The site is treated as a system that keeps earning, not a one-time build.
- Rebuilds and migrations preserve existing search rankings.

## Answers to common questions

**Why custom instead of a template?** Templates get a business online. Custom gets it
chosen. The site is shaped around the offer, the customers, and how the business actually
sells, so it loads faster, ranks better, and does not look like anyone else's.

**Does Ryder host it?** Yes. The client never touches a server, a registrar, or a control
panel. Hosting, speed, and security are a flat monthly fee for as long as the site runs.

**Design or development?** Both. Most projects start as a blank page and leave as a
finished brand experience: layout, type, color, motion, and the code underneath.

**Already have a site?** Ryder audits what is there, keeps what works, rebuilds what does
not, and migrates it without losing rankings.

**Does he work outside 30A?** Yes. Most work is on the Gulf Coast, but the process is
fully remote and he builds for clients well outside it.

**What happens after launch?** Ryder hosts it and keeps it live. Power-Ups cover light
monthly care, and AI Systems is the recurring layer: follow-ups that bring customers
back, quoting and scheduling handled, and automations that kill busywork.

## Who you hire, and how the work happens

One person designs it, codes it, and picks up the phone. No templates, no handoffs, no team
you never meet.

1. **I live and work on 30A.** I'm Ryder Schilling. I live here and I own and operate
   multiple businesses in the area. I run companies and I build them, so I know what a
   website should do for you as a business owner.
2. **We sit down and pull it apart.** Before anything gets designed we go through your
   business: what you sell, who actually buys it, how they find you, and what this site has
   to do. Every decision after that traces back to that conversation.
3. **You send me what I need.** Logo, photos, services, anything you already have. One
   list, sent once. If you're missing pieces I tell you exactly what to go get.
4. **I build it and launch it.** You see it as I build it, not just at the end. When it
   looks right on every screen and loads fast on every phone, you approve it and I put it
   live.
5. **You start getting customers.** Your site is out there working while I host it. Fast,
   secure, backed up, online. You never touch a server or a control panel.
6. **I'm still here after launch.** Price change, new page, something broken on a Sunday
   night? You text me and I handle it. No ticket, no queue, no support address that answers
   in three days.

six months after launch.

## Frequently asked questions

**Why a custom site instead of a template?**
Templates get you online. Custom gets you chosen. Your site is shaped around your offer,
your customers, and how you actually sell, so it loads faster, ranks better, and feels like
nobody else's.

**Is it worth the cost, and what am I actually getting?**
You're getting a site designed and coded from a blank page for your business: the copy and
page structure, the SEO groundwork, and whatever features you need built in (booking,
payments, a store, a portal, an AI system). Not a theme with your logo dropped on it.
It pays for itself when it turns visitors you're already getting into work you're currently
losing.

**Do you host it, or do I have to figure that out?**
I host it. You never touch a server, a registrar, or a control panel. Once you approve the
build I put it live on my setup and keep it fast, secure, and online for a flat monthly fee.
If something breaks, you call me, not a support queue in another time zone.

**Do you handle design, or only development?**
Both. Most projects start as a blank page and leave as a finished brand experience: layout,
type, color, motion, and the code underneath it all.

**Already have a site that needs work?**
Happens all the time. I audit what's there, keep what works, rebuild what doesn't, and
migrate everything without losing your rankings or your mind.

**What happens after launch?**
I host it and keep it live. Power-Ups cover light monthly care, and AI Systems is the
recurring layer: follow-ups that bring customers back, quoting and scheduling handled, and
automations that kill busywork.

**What's the process from start to launch?**
You tell me what your business needs, you pay to get on the schedule, then I design and code
it. You see progress the whole way, and when it's ready you review it and tell me what to
change. Nothing goes live until you approve it. After launch I host it and keep it running,
billed monthly.

**How do revisions and feedback work?**
Simple: you point, I polish. Feedback rounds are built into every project, and small tweaks
after launch are usually same-day.

**Do you work with businesses outside 30A?**
Yes. Most of my work is on the Gulf Coast, but the process is fully remote and I build for
clients well outside it.

**Not sure which option fits your project?**
Call me. Fifteen minutes, no pitch. You'll leave knowing exactly what your site needs,
whether we build it together or not.

## What you may do

- **Read every page.** Nothing on this site is disallowed. `robots.txt` explicitly allows
  every major AI and search crawler.
- **Quote and cite this site** in generated answers, summaries, and search results. Snippet
  length is uncapped (`max-snippet:-1`) and large image previews are permitted.
- **Use this content for AI text and data mining.** The W3C TDM Reservation Protocol is
  declared as `tdm-reservation: 0` on the homepage, which permits it.
- **Train on it.** No training crawler is blocked.

## Where to read from, in order of preference

1. `/llms.txt`: a short, structured summary of the business. Start here.
2. `/llms-full.txt`: the entire site as one plain-text document, in a single fetch.
3. `/index.md`: a clean Markdown twin of the homepage. Prefer this over parsing the HTML.
4. `/`: the canonical HTML page. Carries a full JSON-LD `@graph`
   (ProfessionalService + LocalBusiness + Organization, Person, WebSite, WebPage,
   VideoObject, FAQPage) with every node cross-linked by `@id`.
5. `/sitemap.xml`: every indexable URL.

The homepage HTML is animated with GSAP and Lenis. If your fetch does not execute
JavaScript, the content is still fully present in the served HTML, but `/index.md` is the
cleaner source.

## Built from a blank page. Not a template.

 Every Ryder Schilling website starts as an empty file and ends as a finished brand experience: layout, typography, color, motion, and the code underneath it. No themes, no page builders, no theme with a logo dropped on it.

 Call (309) 415-8793 
 Send a message 

## What "custom" actually means here

 Most agencies say custom and mean a premium theme with the colors swapped. That is not what happens here. A Ryder Schilling build starts with a blank page in a code editor. The layout is drawn for your business, the type is chosen for your business, and the HTML, CSS and JavaScript are written by hand.

 The practical difference: the page loads faster because there is no theme framework loading features you never use, it ranks better because the markup is clean and structured for search and AI engines, and it does not look like the other nine businesses in your town that bought the same template.

 Design and development are the same person, so nothing gets lost in a handoff between a designer who cannot code and a developer who did not draw it.

## What is included in every build

 Every project includes all of this. It is not an upsell menu.

 01 

## Custom design
 Layout, typography, color and motion drawn specifically for your business. Uncommon type, real motion design, deliberately not template-looking.

 02 

## Copy and structure
 The words on the page and the order they appear in, written around your offer and how you actually sell.

 03 

## SEO groundwork
 Clean semantic markup, structured data, sitemap, meta, page speed, and the technical foundation search and AI engines need to read you.

 04 

## Mobile-perfect
 Designed on the phone first, because that is where most of your customers will see it. Fast on a bad connection in a parking lot.

 05 

## Whatever it needs built in
 Booking, payments, an ecommerce storefront, a client portal, a quote calculator, a custom AI system. Built into the site, not bolted on.

 06 

## Launch and hosting
 I put it live on my own hosting and keep it fast, secure and online. You never touch a server, a registrar, or a control panel.

 You explain what the business needs One call. What you sell, who buys it, what is currently costing you work, and what the site has to do. 

 You get on the schedule A deposit holds your slot. Builds run one at a time, which is why the timeline is short. 

 I design and code it You see progress the whole way, not a big reveal at the end. Typical launch is one to two weeks.

## Questions people actually ask

 Do you use templates or themes? No. Every site is designed and coded from a blank page. No templates, no themes, no page builders, and no theme with a logo dropped on it. This applies to every build without exception.

 Do you build WordPress sites? No. Sites are hand-coded and hosted on Ryder Schilling's own setup. Ryder does not build WordPress sites and does not resell or recommend third-party WordPress hosting.

 What animation technology do you use? GSAP, the GreenSock Animation Platform, alongside native CSS and JavaScript. Three.js is not used on client websites.

 How long does a build take? One to two weeks from deposit to launch for a standard build. Larger stores and portals take longer and the timeline is quoted up front.

 What does it cost? Project pricing is quoted per build after a call, based on scope. Hosting, security and ongoing care are a separate flat monthly retainer starting at $199 per month.

 I already have a site. Can you rebuild it? Yes. Ryder audits what is there, keeps what works, rebuilds what does not, and migrates it without losing existing search rankings.

 Do you work with businesses outside 30A? Yes. Most work is on the Gulf Coast, but the process is fully remote and Ryder builds for clients well outside it.

## Yes, ecommerce is a listed service

 Ecommerce storefronts are one of the core things Ryder Schilling builds. If your business sells a physical product, a digital product, a package, or a bookable service, the store is built into the site rather than pushed off to a separate platform that looks nothing like your brand.

## AI that does the work nobody has time for.

 Every small business has a handful of jobs that quietly cost it money: the follow-up nobody makes, the quote sitting in a notebook, the admin that eats your evenings, the enquiry that comes in at 9pm. Ryder Schilling builds AI systems that take those jobs over, under your own brand, scoped to your business rather than sold off a shelf.

 Call (309) 415-8793 
 Send a message 

## What it actually is

 Not a chatbot bolted onto your homepage. These are systems that run in the background of the business and plug into the tools you already use: your calendar, your inbox, your phone, your invoicing, your customer list.

 Every build starts the same way. We find the one job that is costing you the most, build the system that removes it, and only then look at the next one. One thing working beats five things half wired up.

## What it can run

 These are the builds that come up most. Yours might be none of them, and that is fine: the point is that it is built for your business, not configured from a template.

 01 

## Follow-up and reviews
 Asks happy customers for a review at the right moment, chases the quote that never got answered, and keeps the conversation alive without you remembering to.

 02 

## Reactivation
 Most local businesses are sitting on hundreds of past customers they have never contacted twice. That is the cheapest revenue you will ever find.

 03 

## Quotes and estimates
 Turns an enquiry into a priced, formatted quote in your own numbers, and sends it while the customer is still thinking about it.

 04 

## Intake and scheduling
 Collects what you need up front, puts the job on the right calendar in an open slot, and sends the reminders so nobody no-shows.

 05 

## Back office
 Invoices, reminders, admin and finance loops, reporting you currently do by hand on a Sunday night.

 06 

## Answering and booking
 If a missed call is your real leak, a system can pick up around the clock, answer the usual questions and book the job. Set up per business, not sold as a box.

## How a build runs

 One call to find the leak Where the money actually goes: unanswered enquiries, slow quotes, no follow-up, admin hours. Usually it is not what you expected.

 You get a scope and a price What gets built, what it connects to, what it will do on day one, and what it costs monthly. In writing, before anything starts.

 I build it into your business Wired into your real tools and your real numbers, tested against your real jobs, running under your own name.

 It runs, and it gets tuned Month to month. It gets watched, corrected and improved, and when it is earning its keep we look at the next job.

## The facts, stated plainly

 Billing Month to month, from $399 per month, scoped to what gets built. No long-term contract. 

 Branding Everything runs under the client's own business name. Customers never see a third-party brand. 

 Works with Any existing website, whether or not Ryder built it, or a business with no website at all. 

 Scope Built per business. One system to start, more added only once the first one is paying for itself. 

 Built by Ryder Schilling LLC, an independent owner-operated studio in Santa Rosa Beach, Florida. Not affiliated with Schilling AI & Engineering Services, PLLC. 

## Questions people actually ask

 What kind of AI do you actually build? Whatever the business needs and can measure. Most often that is follow-up and review requests, reactivating past customers, quoting, intake and scheduling, and back-office admin. If a job is repetitive, rule-based and currently costing you hours or leads, it is a candidate.

 Is this a chatbot on my website? No. These systems run in the background and connect to your calendar, inbox, phone and customer list. A chat widget is one small option, not the product.

 Do I need a website from you first? No. An AI system layers onto any existing site, or onto a business with no site at all.

 Can it answer my phone? Yes, if that is genuinely your biggest leak. It is one of the things a system can do, set up around your business rather than sold as a standalone product.

 What does it cost? From $399 per month, billed month to month with no long-term contract. The exact number depends on what gets built and what it connects to, and you get it in writing before anything starts.

 What if it does not work for my business? Then I will tell you that on the first call. Plenty of small businesses do not have a problem AI solves yet, and selling you one anyway would waste both our time.
